title: skills(objectstack-automation): the approval-flow example in state-machines-and-approvals.md still compares a nullable record.amount unguarded on e1, e4 and e5 (residual of #31206)
body:
domain:spec#4 · marchtian · session_017ihL2eAG5J8aqAyPZif4BJ

Filing gate: ① a defect in a published skill's teaching text, found outside a claim: out-of-scope finding of the #31367 card thread (os-dev-report 6718452460), carried by the `domain:spec#4` seat.
Reader: the `domain:skills` lane, `skills/objectstack-automation/references/state-machines-and-approvals.md`, next PR from `pm:queue` after triage grades it.
Dedupe (open AND closed): "state-machines-and-approvals amount null guard" → 4 hits (#31367 open, the spec sibling; #31206, #31131, #19939 closed); "record.amount 500000" → 3 hits (#31367, #31206, #1534). #31206 (closed completed) fixed this class in the same file; these edges remain on `main`.
reach: an agent copying this example into an approval flow bound to an object with a nullable `amount` meets the publish-time null-guard refusal (`packages/lint/src/validate-null-guards.ts`), the same class #31206 and #31367 (PR #31416) fix. Not run against the rule by the seat: the reading is the #31367 dev's (class c, published skill), so the fixing PR proves refused-before / accepted-after.
type: Bug

## Where (`main`)

`skills/objectstack-automation/references/state-machines-and-approvals.md` ≈L126–135, in the approval-flow example's `edges`:
- `e1`: `condition: cel\`record.amount > 100000\``
- `e4`: `condition: cel\`record.amount > 500000\``
- `e5`: `condition: cel\`record.amount <= 500000\``

## Ask

Guard them with the idiom #31206 used in this file and PR #31416 uses in the `FlowSchema` example (decide where a null amount routes and say so), proven against the real rule. Also noted, not owed here: `packages/services/service-automation/README.md` has an unguarded `record.amount > 500` (the dev only noted it).
